items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I enjoyed the group with Shearing was a mixed group in those days. Like two black guys, right? Milt, Clark.

ctx.x: Johnnie Ray? As the vibist for…
But I think Cal Tjader was the one that made a little more of a name for himself, of course. He was really possessed by Milt Jackson.
